[EN] The basilisks migrate here and there depending on whether or not they're laying eggs or hatching.

I wish they would just migrate away and not bother us again.
[ES] Los basiliscos migran de aquí para allá dependiendo de si están poniendo huevos o eclosionando.

Ojalá simplemente migraran lejos y no volvieran a molestarnos.
